title: Biochemical Analysis of Quail Blood
author: Gamal Mehaisen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s7yehpw

steps.title: Collect and store plasma
steps.instruction: Collect blood into heparinized tubes, centrifuge at 2000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, separate the plasma and store it at –20 °C until analysis.

steps.title: TBARS assay with TBA
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL Thiobarbituric Acid (TBA) solution to 200 µL standard and 200 µL test samples, incubate the mixture at 95 °C for 60 min, cool in an ice bath for 10 min, pipette 200 µL from each 800 µL reaction into a 96‑well microplate and measure absorbance at 532 nm immediately.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL TBA to 200 µL standard and 200 µL test sample.
Incubate at 95 °C for 60 min.
Cool to room temperature in an ice bath for 10 min.
Transfer 200 µL of each reaction to a 96‑well plate.
Measure OD at 532 nm immediately.

steps.title: First colorimetric assay
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL reagent R1 (100 mmol phosphate buffer, 200 mmol DL‑Alanine, 6 mmol 2‑Oxoglutarate, 12 mmol sodium azide) to 100 µL distilled water or sample, mix and incubate 30 min at 37 °C; add 0.5 mL reagent R2 (2,4‑dinitrophenyl hydrazine), mix and incubate 20 min at 20‑25 °C; add 0.5 mL 0.4 mol L⁻¹ NaOH, wait 5 min and read absorbance at 546 nm (sensitivity 4 U/L, analytical range 4‑94 U/L).

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL R1 (100 mmol phosphate buffer, 200 mmol DL‑Alanine, 6 mmol 2‑Oxoglutarate, 12 mmol sodium azide) to 100 µL water or sample; mix; incubate 30 min at 37 °C.
Add 0.5 mL R2 (2,4‑dinitrophenyl hydrazine); mix; incubate 20 min at 20‑25 °C.
Add 0.5 mL 0.4 mol L⁻¹ NaOH; wait 5 min.
Measure absorbance at 546 nm (sensitivity 4 U/L, range 4‑94 U/L).

steps.title: Second colorimetric assay
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL reagent R1 (100 mmol phosphate buffer, 100 mmol L‑aspartate, 5 mmol 2‑Oxoglutarate, 140 mmol sodium hydroxide, 12 mmol sodium azide) to 100 µL distilled water or sample, mix and incubate 30 min at 37 °C; add 0.5 mL reagent R2 (2 mmol 2,4‑dinitrophenyl‑hydrazine and 8.4 % HCl), mix and incubate 20 min at 20‑25 °C; add 0.5 mL 0.4 mol L⁻¹ NaOH, wait 5 min and read absorbance at 546 nm (sensitivity 7 U/L, analytical range 7‑89 U/L).

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL R1 (100 mmol phosphate buffer, 100 mmol L‑aspartate, 5 mmol 2‑Oxoglutarate, 140 mmol NaOH, 12 mmol sodium azide) to 100 µL water or sample; mix; incubate 30 min at 37 °C.
Add 0.5 mL R2 (2 mmol 2,4‑dinitrophenyl‑hydrazine, 8.4 % HCl); mix; incubate 20 min at 20‑25 °C.
Add 0.5 mL 0.4 mol L⁻¹ NaOH; wait 5 min.
Measure absorbance at 546 nm (sensitivity 7 U/L, range 7‑89 U/L).

steps.title: Triglyceride assay
steps.instruction: Add 1.0 mL prepared reagent to 10 µL standard triglyceride (200 mg/dL) or test sample, mix and incubate 5 min at 37 °C; measure absorbance at 546 nm within 30 min and calculate concentration as (A_sp / A_st) × 200 mg/dL.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.0 mL reagent to 10 µL standard (200 mg/dL) or sample; mix; incubate 5 min at 37 °C.
Measure absorbance at 546 nm within 30 min.
Calculate triglyceride concentration: (A_sp / A_st) × 200 mg/dL.

steps.title: Cholesterol assay
steps.instruction: Add 1.0 mL prepared reagent to 10 µL standard cholesterol (200 mg/dL) or test sample, mix and incubate 5 min at 37 °C; measure absorbance at 546 nm within 30 min and calculate concentration as (A_sp / A_st) × 200 mg/dL.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.0 mL reagent to 10 µL standard (200 mg/dL) or sample; mix; incubate 5 min at 37 °C.
Measure absorbance at 546 nm within 30 min.
Calculate cholesterol concentration: (A_sp / A_st) × 200 mg/dL.

steps.title: Calcium assay
steps.instruction: Mix 0.5 mL R1 (0.3 mol 2‑Amino‑2‑methyl‑1‑propanol, pH 10.5) with 0.5 mL R2 (0.16 mmol O‑cresolphthalein complexone, 7 mmol 8‑hydroxyquinoline); add the mixture to 10 µL standard calcium (10 mg/dL) or test sample, incubate 5 min at 20‑25 °C, measure absorbance at 578 nm and calculate concentration as (A_sp / A_st) × 10 mg/dL.

substeps.instruction: Prepare mixture: 0.5 mL R1 (0.3 mol 2‑Amino‑2‑methyl‑1‑propanol, pH 10.5) + 0.5 mL R2 (0.16 mmol O‑cresolphthalein complexone, 7 mmol 8‑hydroxyquinoline).
Add mixture to 10 µL standard (10 mg/dL) or sample; incubate 5 min at 20‑25 °C.
Measure absorbance at 578 nm.
Calculate calcium concentration: (A_sp / A_st) × 10 mg/dL.

steps.title: Phosphorus assay
steps.instruction: Add 1.0 mL reagent (3.5 mmol ammonium molybdate, 750 mmol sulphuric acid, 1 % surfactants) to 10 µL blank (distilled water), standard (5 mg/dL phosphorus) or test sample, mix and wait 5 min at 37 °C; measure absorbance at 340 nm within 30 min and calculate concentration as (A_sp / A_st) × 5 mg/dL.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.0 mL reagent to 10 µL blank, standard (5 mg/dL) or sample; mix; wait 5 min at 37 °C.
Measure absorbance at 340 nm within 30 min.
Calculate phosphorus concentration: (A_sp / A_st) × 5 mg/dL.

steps.title: Total protein assay
steps.instruction: Add 1.0 mL reagent (750 mmol sodium hydroxide, 12 mmol copper sulphate, 40.9 mmol sodium potassium tartrate, 19.8 mmol potassium iodide) to 20 µL standard total protein (6 mg/dL) or test sample, mix and incubate 10 min at room temperature; measure absorbance at 546 nm within 30 min and calculate concentration as (A_sp / A_st) × 6 mg/dL.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.0 mL reagent to 20 µL standard (6 mg/dL) or sample; mix; incubate 10 min at room temperature.
Measure absorbance at 546 nm within 30 min.
Calculate protein concentration: (A_sp / A_st) × 6 mg/dL.

steps.title: Albumin assay
steps.instruction: Add 1.0 mL reagent (100 mmol acetate buffer, 0.27 mmol bromocresol green, detergent) to 10 µL standard albumin (4 g/dL) or test sample, mix and incubate approximately 5 min at 20‑25 °C; measure absorbance at 623 nm within 60 min and calculate concentration as (A_sp / A_st) × 4 mg/dL.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.0 mL reagent to 10 µL standard (4 g/dL) or sample; mix; incubate ~5 min at 20‑25 °C.
Measure absorbance at 623 nm within 60 min.
Calculate albumin concentration: (A_sp / A_st) × 4 mg/dL.

steps.title: ELISA primary protocol
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL standard and sample to each well, add 50 µL antibody immediately, mix for 30 s and cover; incubate 30 min at 25 °C; aspirate and wash with 250 µL Wash Buffer four times, blot dry; add 100 µL HRP‑conjugate, cover and incubate 30 min at 25 °C; wash four times as before; add 100 µL TMB substrate, incubate 15 min at 25 °C protected from light; add 50 µL stop solution, tap to mix; read optical density within 5 min at 450 nm, 540 nm or 570 nm and subtract the 540 nm or 570 nm reading from the 450 nm reading.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL standard and sample per well.
Add 50 µL antibody immediately; mix 30 s; cover.
Incubate 30 min at 25 °C.
Aspirate; wash with 250 µL Wash Buffer; repeat for a total of four washes; blot dry.
Add 100 µL HRP‑conjugate; cover; incubate 30 min at 25 °C.
Wash four times as above.
Add 100 µL TMB substrate; incubate 15 min at 25 °C protected from light.
Add 50 µL stop solution; tap to mix.
Measure OD within 5 min at 450 nm, 540 nm or 570 nm; subtract 540 nm or 570 nm values from 450 nm.

steps.title: ELISA with blank control
steps.instruction: Set a blank well with no solution, add 50 µL standard and sample to each well, add 50 µL HRP‑conjugate (1×) immediately, mix for 60 s and cover; incubate 40 min at 37 °C; aspirate and wash with 250 µL Wash Buffer four times, blot dry; add 90 µL TMB substrate, incubate 20 min at 37 °C protected from light; add 50 µL stop solution, tap to mix; read optical density within 5 min at 450 nm, 540 nm or 570 nm and subtract the 540 nm or 570 nm reading from the 450 nm reading.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a blank well (no solution).
Add 50 µL standard and sample per well.
Add 50 µL HRP‑conjugate (1×) immediately; mix 60 s; cover.
Incubate 40 min at 37 °C.
Aspirate; wash with 250 µL Wash Buffer; repeat for a total of four washes; blot dry.
Add 90 µL TMB substrate; incubate 20 min at 37 °C protected from light.
Add 50 µL stop solution; tap to mix.
Measure OD within 5 min at 450 nm, 540 nm or 570 nm; subtract 540 nm or 570 nm values from 450 nm.
